validation_scope: Runner eligibility only: focal mapping, reproducible dependency availability, perturbation round-trip, and five-run base determinism. This is not the separate Phase 0 source/test red-green discrimination result.

protocol.section: C. The arms ladder; sizing decisions fixed 2026-08-25
protocol.decision: Build Go and Java runners as independently gated instruments before the arms run; a failed site gate is a recorded rejection.

runner.source_manifest_canonicalization: For each source_manifest entry in stored order: lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, path with the instruments/arms/go/ prefix removed, then LF; include the final LF. The code-only manifest uses the first eight entries and the full manifest uses all ten.

population.predicate: both_sides_touched_tests=true in corpus/conflicts for hashicorp/terraform and gohugoio/hugo

focal_selection_rule.diff: For each parent Pi, git diff --unified=0 --find-renames B Pi restricted to _test.go paths.
focal_selection_rule.identity: A hunk maps only when its non-empty old or new range overlaps a top-level, receiver-free FuncDecl satisfying Go's lexical TestXxx naming convention; TestMain is excluded. The mapper does not type-check the signature, and the fail-closed gate requires go test to emit a terminal event for every expected parent.
focal_selection_rule.subtests: A table-driven or t.Run closure hunk maps to the enclosing parent TestXxx; subtest names are not frozen independently.
focal_selection_rule.support_hunks: Package/import/fixture/helper-only hunks are counted as unmapped and never guessed.
focal_selection_rule.base_resolution: Mapped names are partitioned into present versus absent at B, per package. Each parent must contribute at least one base-present name.
focal_selection_rule.regexp: For each package, sort and regexp-escape base-present names and emit exactly ^(?:TestA|TestB)$; invoke packages separately.

perturbation_rule.insertion: Insert a newline-delimited panic("perturbed") immediately after the opening brace of every top-level ast.FuncDecl body.
perturbation_rule.closures: ast.FuncLit bodies are not traversed or independently perturbed.
excluded_files: leading standard Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT. marker
no named function or method body
perturbation_rule.restoration: Capture original bytes and SHA-256, install cleanup before first write, restore captured bytes rather than printed AST, then require byte equality and SHA equality.
perturbation_rule.crash_boundary: Catchable interrupts kill the child and restore; uncatchable termination or power loss cannot be guaranteed, so operation is confined to disposable scratch checkouts with post-use Git checks.

determinism_rule.pass_condition: Every command exits zero; every expected parent Test reaches a terminal event; at least one parent passes; exact-base state is unchanged; five sorted normalized signatures are identical and non-empty.
determinism_rule.normalization: Sorted (requested package, full parent/subtest name, pass|fail|skip, TF_ACC guard); timing, output text, elapsed fields, and event order ignored.
determinism_rule.tf_acc: TF_ACC is removed. A skip is attributed to TF_ACC only when its emitted skip output contains TF_ACC. Every all-skipped set rejects, but a generic guard message receives only a generic rejection.
determinism_rule.full_suite: Never run; only mapped focal package/name subsets are invoked.

environment.install: project-local tools/go/ (ignored build dependency, not a system install)
environment.network_boundary: GOPROXY=off plus disabled direct VCS/private-module routes prevents Go dependency retrieval during gates; this is not an operating-system firewall for arbitrary test network calls.
environment.parser_compatibility: Go 1.16 parser supports these 2013-2018 candidate bases; it does not support later generics syntax.
